Notes:
- Gobkit characters are fully textured/rigged with named clips (Idle, Walk, Run, Attack, Hit, Death, Special). They do not expose separate hair/skin/eye material slots; customization will require material/texture swaps or a dedicated customizable base mesh later.
- Teen Zombie is rigged with animation (source-reported) but clip names were not verified in Unity.
- Slender Grey Xeno is static (no rig/animation) and is a placeholder mutant candidate until a rigged humanoid mutant is found.
- Steel Helmet, Ski Backpack and Plaster Jacket are static props; wearable attachment points and skinning must be configured in Unity.
- No Unity import, prefab creation, or runtime test has been performed; Unity Editor is unavailable in this environment.
